key: ["A trading company becomes the ruler of Bengal. Plassey, then Buxar, then the right to collect Bengal's revenue. From there it fights and annexes its way across the subcontinent. Mysore, the Peshwa's lands, Sindh, the Punjab, Awadh. Where it does not annex, it leaves a prince on his throne and a British Resident at his side. It surveys, it taxes, it lays rail and wire. And in 1857 its own soldiers rise against it.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
